detail: Datamint | Rust Systems Engineer, Browser Security | Remote (Global) | Full-time | $120k–$170k + Equity | https://datamint.xyz We build high-throughput crawling and structured data extraction infra designed for AI agents and LLM pipelines. If you’ve built scrapers recently, you already know the state of the market: - Traditional proxy providers (Bright Data, Oxylabs, Smartproxy, Proxybase) give you raw IPs or massive unparsed HTML blobs, leaving you to deal with DOM bloat, token waste, and brittle parsing pipelines. - Modern tools like Firecrawl or Jina made clean Markdown extraction easy for hobby setups, but they often struggle when you throw heavy SPAs, high-concurrency jobs, or hardened anti-bot walls (Cloudflare Under-Attack / Turnstile, Kasada, DataDome) at them. - Rolling your own Playwright / Puppeteer cluster works until target sites deploy new JA4/TLS fingerprints, and your data team ends up spending 30% of their sprints fixing broken crawlers instead of shipping product. We're tackling this by combining a low-latency Rust fast-fetch engine (JA4/TLS and HTTP/2 frame emulation) with an isolated stealth browser fleet, zero-code schema validation (JSON Schema/Pydantic), and native Model Context Protocol (MCP) support. We are looking for a Senior Backend (Node.js / Nest.js) Developer to join our fast-growing network. You’ll be responsible for building modern and scalable web applications, working closely with backend developers and designers to create intuitive user experiences.

This is a long-term, full-time remote role with opportunities to work on innovative projects that make a difference.

  • Strong expertise in Node.js and Nest.js frameworks.
  • Proven experience building REST and/or GraphQL APIs.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript.
  • Solid experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB).
  • Familiarity with authentication/authorization mechanisms (JWT, OAuth2).
  • Experience with unit/integration testing (e.g., Jest, Mocha).
  • Proficiency with Git and version control workflows.
  • Located in CET timezone (+/- 3 hours), we are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

 

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline
